title: The Last Promise Anew
author: Ada Joubert
blurb: Zephyrine Sandoval, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
